description: Why Fresh Roasted Coffee? Because it's not just a name. It's how we do business. Most orders are roasted the same night and shipped the next day. I don't care that I've been wearing makeup for decades now. I never get tired of playing with it and I feel it gives me a pulled-together look and a look that says I care about my appearance. In fact, I was able to be a receptionist for a billion-dollar company even in my late fifties. The makeup helped me look "polished."

I think a mistake women make is to be scared to use bright colors if they are older, if their skin isn't "perfect," and if they feel their features aren't "perfect." Hogwash! Brights look GOOD on ANYONE, it turns out! Not only do the COLORS look good, the CONFIDENCE shown is appealing, too! I no longer ask myself, "Oh, what will people think?" when choosing makeup and clothes. I ask myself, "Do YOU like this?" instead! Life's too short, people!

Well, I'm talking a big talk, but I did apply the color lightly, just a dot on each side of the bow of the lip, then spread it out with my pinkie to corners for the top (put a dot, pull to side, put the other dot, pull to side), and a bigger dot on the bottom lip and pulled to each side with the pinkie. It gave a wonderful pop of color without emphasizing the lines around my lips. If you are young or don't have the lines yet, use the precise foam brush to fill in the lip with color, instead of spreading a small amount out with your pinkie. On my daughter-in-law, the solid, intense color looks fantastic. 

When applied lightly, this color is a vibrant pink with purple tone. When applied solidly, it looks more purple, but not a blue-based purple. It's a red-based, meaning it is more in the pink family.

The name is truthful: Color-STAY. Yes, it stays and stays. I don't even retouch during the day.

Have you seen Lipsense's Violet Reign? This reminds me of it, color-wise. Lipsense is all the rage, but I don't like it. I like, frankly, the Revlon and the Maybelline long-lasting (and 24-hour) lip colors. I don't use the gloss end of the lipstick (it comes with the foam tilted coloring-in brush on one end, and a pointed brush-like tip for the gloss on the other) because I like a matte lip with bright colors. Overall, very good shoes for the price.","title":"Affordable basketball shoes"},{"name":"Wra███erG███","rating":3,"review":"At first glance, these FUBU Knight shoes appear to be well-constructed. The matte black suede is very smooth; the tongue is adequately padded, and the tread on the sole will undoubtedly provide above-average grip on regular solid surfaces.

Straight out of the box, I clipped off the small metal tags on the shoe laces using a diagonal sidecutter tool (I didn't remove the laces to remove the small metal tabs). It was then that I noticed that the shoe laces are wider than normal laces and flat, almost like cloth tape – to each his own, I suppose, but I don't think this kind of shoe lace is going to last as long as a regular shoe lace would.

I also immediately removed the “insole” with a bit of coaxing since there is a small amount of adhesive on the bottom of them. They are disappointingly below-average, almost just a very thin piece of foam. With no effort whatsoever, I was able to actually tear them in half...and into the trash can they went, which was my intention. I instantly replaced them with ***Spenco Heavy Duty*** insoles ($18-20/pair, depending on where you buy ‘em) which I have been using exclusively in ALL of my shoes and boots for almost 30 years.

Finally, I liberally coated them with Scotchguard leather waterproofing spray (approx. $10/can). I allowed them to dry for a couple of days and they were just fine. Oftentimes, this Scotchguard spray slightly darkens leathers, but this suede is black so there was no change in color.

With an already-broken-in pair of replacement shoes on hand, I wore these FUBU Knight shoes, as modified, for about 12 hours straight, with a lot of walking, a lot of standing, and only occasionally sitting down. These shoes required almost no breaking in and were surprisingly comfortable, given the low price. My legs and feet were not completely free of muscle soreness at the end of the day, but the soreness was not significant. I am certain, given almost 3 decades of experience, that the Spenco insoles made all the difference in the world. However, these FUBU shoes are well worth the inexpensive price.

The sizing is true: I wear a size 9 medium and this pair of shoes is a size 9 medium. They fit perfectly, even with heavy socks, were easy to tighten up with the laces, and at the end of the day, I had no sore spots on my feet.

Note: I was provided this pair of shoes at no cost, in exchange for an honest and unbiased review of them. The quality of these shoes is slightly higher than I anticipated and while they're not really my “style,” I'll certainly continue to wear them since they are completely matte black. Overall, I would recommend this FUBU Knight shoe with an insole replacement and a heavy coating of Scotchguard waterproofing spray. For the cost, this shoe IS a solid value.","title":"Good shoe for a good price!"},{"name":"John","rating":3,"review":"I really like the looks of these shoes, there are tons of small details that make it look like a higher-price shoe. [{"name":"Instructions","value":"Step 1: Prep for makeup. Prime clean skin with ColorStay™ GRIP Matte Primer to create a flawless base for foundation application. 

Step 2: For a soft, radiant matte look, apply 1-2 pumps of ColorStay™Longwear Makeup Foundation for Combination/Oily skin using your fingers or a Revlon® Buffing Foundation Brush. Dot onto your cheeks, chin, forehead, and nose and blend starting at the center of your face. Buff out in circular motions one area at a time until you build your desired finish.

Step 3: Repeat over any area where you want more coverage.

Step 4: Conceal imperfections. Dot on ColorStay™ Skin Awaken  5-in-1 Concealer over blemishes, dark spots, and undereye circles. 

Step 5: Set your look for all-day shine control and a flawless matte finish that lasts. Dip the very ends of your Revlon® Kabuki Brush into ColorStay™ BLOT Setting Powder and gently sweep and dust the silky-soft powder across your face. Use sparingly to maintain your matte look.

Boost your freshly applied look with ColorStay™ LOCK Setting Mist, formulated to lock makeup in place for up to 24 hours."}]

description: Local Hive Southwest Raw & Unfiltered Honey is a blend of light and smooth honey from Southwest beekeepers balanced with the classic taste of premium 100% U.S. Honey. The result is an unforgettable, sweet all-American honey. We bottle this raw & unfiltered honey so you can taste every drop just the way the bees made it. Our commitment to "100% U.S. Honey" means that we never compromise on quality and purity. Many imported honeys from foreign countries (including some organic honey) have been found to be mislabeled or even diluted with other sweeteners. Local Hive Honey is always bottled raw & unfiltered to keep the delicate flavors from the pollen inside intact. This can lead to graininess, discoloration, or crystallized (hardened) honey. All of these are natural and are signs of high-quality honey. If your honey is granulated or crystallized, it has not necessarily spoiled. Place it in 110º warm water until it reliquifies. More than 150 American beekeepers produce the honey that Local Hive bottles. Some of these beekeepers have been sending us honey for generations. Some send us Christmas cards, too. Bottled at Local Hive HQ in Greeley, Colorado. Do not feed to children under the age of one. Always keep Local Hive Honey in a cool, dry place away from direct light the the cap sealed.
